Public Arabic coverage for the no-silent-reversal control (the private Arabic PDFs are gitignored, so the control can never see them on the public mirror). Built by tools/gen_actualtext_fixture.py: logical Arabic text in /ActualText over Latin glyphs; regenerate with `python3 tools/gen_actualtext_fixture.py ar`. producer_class=logical because the /ActualText payload IS the logical string (no visual reordering involved). Contains lam-alef inside السلام. Words asserted by crates/pdfrtl-core/tests/no_silent_reversal.rs: السلام, مرحبا (pure RTL, >= 4 letters).

Niqqud-free by design. Words asserted by crates/pdfrtl-core/tests/no_silent_reversal.rs: שלום, עולם, תודה (pure RTL, >= 4 letters — three-letter words give false positives, e.g. דוח inside חודש).
